problem: Equal proper parallel segments joined on the same sides give equal proper parallel joining segments
litex_code:
# Book I.33: same-side joins of equal and parallel proper segments.
# Positive direction dot product expresses the noncrossed endpoint pairing.
thm proposition_33:
    ? forall a, b, c, d cart(R, R):
        $parallel::are_parallel_lines(a, b, c, d)
        $geometry::main::are_segments_congruent(a, b, c, d)
        geometry::main::dot(geometry::main::vec(a, b), geometry::main::vec(c, d)) > 0
        =>:
            $parallel::are_parallel_lines(a, c, b, d)
            $geometry::main::are_segments_congruent(a, c, b, d)
    by def $parallel::are_parallel_lines(a, b, c, d)
    by def $geometry::main::is_parallel(a, b, c, d)
    by def $geometry::main::are_segments_congruent(a, b, c, d)
    have u cart(R, R) = geometry::main::vec(a, b)
    have v cart(R, R) = geometry::main::vec(c, d)
    release thm geometry::main::distance_sq_positive_of_ne(a, b)
    release thm geometry::main::vec_dot_self_is_distance(a, b)
    release thm geometry::main::vec_dot_self_is_distance(c, d)
    have n R+ = geometry::main::distance_sq(a, b)
    geometry::main::dot(u, u) = geometry::main::distance_sq(a, b) = n
    geometry::main::dot(v, v) = geometry::main::distance_sq(c, d) = n
    geometry::main::det(u, v) = 0
    geometry::main::dot(u, v) = geometry::main::dot(geometry::main::vec(a, b), geometry::main::vec(c, d)) > 0
    release thm geometry::main::dot_squared_plus_det_squared(u, v)
    geometry::main::det(u, v)^2 = 0^2 = 0
    geometry::main::dot(u, v)^2+geometry::main::det(u, v)^2 = geometry::main::dot(u, u)*geometry::main::dot(v, v)
    geometry::main::dot(u, v)^2 = geometry::main::dot(u, v)^2+0 = geometry::main::dot(u, v)^2+geometry::main::det(u, v)^2 = geometry::main::dot(u, u)*geometry::main::dot(v, v) = n*n = n^2
    geometry::main::dot(u, v)*n > 0
    geometry::main::dot(u, v)*n >= 0
    release thm angle_measure::same_square_and_sign_gives_equality(geometry::main::dot(u, v), n)
    release thm geometry::main::dot_coordinate_formula(u, u)
    release thm geometry::main::dot_coordinate_formula(v, v)
    release thm geometry::main::dot_coordinate_formula(u, v)
    (u(1)-v(1))^2+(u(2)-v(2))^2 = (u(1)*u(1)+u(2)*u(2))+(v(1)*v(1)+v(2)*v(2))-2*(u(1)*v(1)+u(2)*v(2)) = geometry::main::dot(u, u)+geometry::main::dot(v, v)-2*geometry::main::dot(u, v) = n+n-2*n = 0
    (u(1)-v(1))^2 >= 0
    (u(2)-v(2))^2 >= 0
    (u(1)-v(1))^2 = -((u(2)-v(2))^2) <= 0
    (u(1)-v(1))^2 = 0
    u(1)-v(1) = 0
    u(1) = v(1)
    (u(2)-v(2))^2 = -((u(1)-v(1))^2) = 0
    u(2)-v(2) = 0
    u(2) = v(2)
    release thm geometry::main::vec_coordinate_formula(a, b)
    release thm geometry::main::vec_coordinate_formula(c, d)
    b(1)-a(1) = u(1) = v(1) = d(1)-c(1)
    b(2)-a(2) = u(2) = v(2) = d(2)-c(2)
    d(1)-b(1) = (d(1)-c(1))+(c(1)-b(1)) = (b(1)-a(1))+(c(1)-b(1)) = c(1)-a(1)
    d(2)-b(2) = (d(2)-c(2))+(c(2)-b(2)) = (b(2)-a(2))+(c(2)-b(2)) = c(2)-a(2)
    by contra:
        ? a != c
        a = c
        c(1) = a(1)
        c(2) = a(2)
        c(1)-a(1) = 0
        c(2)-a(2) = 0
        release thm geometry::main::collinear_det_expand(a, b, c)
        geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(a, b), geometry::main::vec(a, c)) = (b(1)-a(1))*(c(2)-a(2))-(b(2)-a(2))*(c(1)-a(1)) = (b(1)-a(1))*0-(b(2)-a(2))*0 = 0
        impossible geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(a, b), geometry::main::vec(a, c)) != 0
    by contra:
        ? b != d
        b = d
        c(1)-a(1) = d(1)-b(1) = 0
        c(2)-a(2) = d(2)-b(2) = 0
        c(1) = a(1)
        c(2) = a(2)
        c = (c(1),c(2)) = (a(1),a(2)) = a
        impossible a != c
    release thm geometry::main::vec_coordinate_formula(a, c)
    release thm geometry::main::vec_coordinate_formula(b, d)
    geometry::main::vec(b, d)(1) = d(1)-b(1) = c(1)-a(1) = geometry::main::vec(a, c)(1)
    geometry::main::vec(b, d)(2) = d(2)-b(2) = c(2)-a(2) = geometry::main::vec(a, c)(2)
    release thm geometry::main::det_coordinate_formula(geometry::main::vec(a, c), geometry::main::vec(b, d))
    geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(a, c), geometry::main::vec(b, d)) = geometry::main::vec(a, c)(1)*geometry::main::vec(b, d)(2)-geometry::main::vec(a, c)(2)*geometry::main::vec(b, d)(1) = geometry::main::vec(a, c)(1)*geometry::main::vec(a, c)(2)-geometry::main::vec(a, c)(2)*geometry::main::vec(a, c)(1) = 0
    by def $geometry::main::is_parallel(a, c, b, d)
    release thm geometry::main::det_antisymmetric(geometry::main::vec(a, b), geometry::main::vec(a, c))
    by contra:
        ? -(geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(a, b), geometry::main::vec(a, c))) != 0
        -(geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(a, b), geometry::main::vec(a, c))) = 0
        geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(a, b), geometry::main::vec(a, c)) = -(-(geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(a, b), geometry::main::vec(a, c)))) = -0 = 0
        impossible geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(a, b), geometry::main::vec(a, c)) != 0
    geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(a, c), geometry::main::vec(a, b)) = -(geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(a, b), geometry::main::vec(a, c))) != 0
    by def $parallel::are_parallel_lines(a, c, b, d)
    release thm geometry::main::distance_sq_coordinate_formula(a, c)
    release thm geometry::main::distance_sq_coordinate_formula(b, d)
    geometry::main::distance_sq(b, d) = (d(1)-b(1))^2+(d(2)-b(2))^2 = (c(1)-a(1))^2+(c(2)-a(2))^2 = geometry::main::distance_sq(a, c)
    by def $geometry::main::are_segments_congruent(a, c, b, d)
